provenance: T9 tranche 3 (SHELL stratum + BARE-CODE HEADINGS in both the contents page and the body). Spatializer Audio Laboratories, Inc., sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/890821/000107997415000209/spatz10k12312014.htm, accession 0001079974-15-000209, filed 2015-03-31, FY2014 (Dec-end), 400,322 bytes, HTML. AUTHORED FROM THE DOCUMENT and verified 2026-08-17 by an independent tag-strip scan importing nothing from src/: four occurrences of 'smaller reporting company', four of 'Not applicable', no 'Item 16'. WHAT IT ADDS, AND WHY IT IS THE MOST VALUABLE OF THE THREE: every heading in this filing — contents page AND body, all twenty of each — is a bare 'Item N.' with its title in the next block. That is the JNJ 2016 shape that lost 18 of 21 items in held-out run H1 and forced ADR-013's next-line title promotion. JNJ is the only fixture that exercises it, and JNJ's contents page uses a DIFFERENT shape from its body, so the hard half of ADR-013 — promote next-line titles, then let the TOC-cluster rule tell the promoted contents page apart from the promoted body — has never been tested on a filing where BOTH are bare. This one is. The two anchors are on opposite sides of the boundary the rule has to find (Item 1's first paragraph, Item 1A's first risk heading), text_not_contains pins that Item 1 stops before Item 1A, and max_chars on the two-word items 2 and 3 ('None.') pins that a promoted heading did not leak its title into the next body. Expected GREEN with no new code.
